title: Quantifying lung fissure integrity using a three-dimensional patch-based convolutional neural network on CT images for emphysema treatment planning.
summary: A 3D patch-based CNN segments lung fissures on CT and quantifies fissure integrity in severe emphysema for endobronchial-valve planning. 129 CT scans are assessed against expert-annotated fissure regions; the source reports segmentation and quantitative integrity performance. Testing: Retrospective imaging study; segmentation accuracy does not establish treatment response or patient benefit..
